info.title: dsh-ee Harness API
info.summary: Neutral v1 contract for third-party Harness integration with dsh-ee (read-only subset)
info.description: Static description of the neutral v1 contract that dsh-ee offers to third-party Harnesses. The actual runtime entry points, scopes, models, and apps are described by GET /.well-known/dsh-ee and /v1/capabilities; this file describes the shape, the unified error envelope, and the response headers of these read-only endpoints. The MCP (JSON-RPC) and npm registry protocols are out of scope for this file. All /.well-known/dsh-ee and /v1/* responses carry Dsh-EE-API-Version: 1.

get.description: Returns this instance's entry points, authentication methods, capabilities, and limits. Carries ETag and Cache-Control: private, max-age=300, and supports If-None-Match 304. Endpoint URLs in the document are generated from the request Host / X-Forwarded-* (or the configured PublicURL).

get.summary: Capability summary of the current token (Bearer optional)
get.description: Without Authorization, returns the public subset (authenticated=false, user data as empty arrays). With a token, returns the models, tool counts, micro apps, skill summaries, and catalog revision permitted by the token scopes and the account permissions. An invalid token returns 401 instead of silently degrading to anonymous. Response Cache-Control: no-store.
Returns only the public model names allowed by the quota and the token; upstream vendor model names are not exposed. Requires the models scope plus the account llm.use permission.

post.summary: Anthropic Messages compatibility (requests converted to OpenAI chat; alias /anthropic/v1/messages)
post.description: Claude Code / Anthropic SDK compatibility entry point: call models connected to dsh-ee with an enterprise token (x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer). Requests are converted to OpenAI chat completions and reuse the model permissions, monthly quota, upstream failover, and usage accounting of /v1/chat/completions; responses and streaming SSE are converted back to the Anthropic shape. Only POST /v1/messages is implemented (plus the alias POST /anthropic/v1/messages with identical behavior); count_tokens / batches / Files API return 404. If the first candidate route (highest priority) has provider vendor=deepseek, the request is passed through natively: it is forwarded directly to <provider.base>/anthropic/v1/messages, only model is rewritten, anthropic-version/anthropic-beta are passed through as-is, and the response JSON/SSE is forwarded byte-for-byte without parsing extension blocks such as server tools/citations/safety; other vendors fall back to OpenAI chat conversion (anthropic-version/anthropic-beta are ignored). Failover only happens within the same vendor/protocol, never across protocols. The Files API itself is not implemented. The error body uses the Anthropic shape (AnthropicError).

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: Enterprise token; equivalent to Authorization: Bearer; x-api-key takes precedence when both are present

200.description: Anthropic message; Anthropic SSE event stream when stream=true (message_start → content_block_* → message_delta → message_stop)

400.description: Request body is not JSON, model/max_tokens is missing, a parameter is out of range, or an unsupported content block is used (invalid_request_error)

403.description: Token lacks the models scope, the account lacks llm.use, the model is out of range, or the quota has expired (permission_error)

404.description: No usable upstream for the public model, or an unimplemented compatibility endpoint such as count_tokens (not_found_error)

429.description: Account/token quota exhausted, per-token rate limit, or upstream 429 (rate_limit_error)

502.description: All upstream routes unavailable, or the upstream response cannot be parsed (api_error)

bearerAuth.description: Employee access token; obtained via the device code flow or the 'My tokens' page on the web. Scopes are intersected with the account RBAC.

apiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: Anthropic-compatible endpoints also accept x-api-key: <token>, equivalent to Authorization: Bearer.

codes.description: Stable error codes currently returned by new neutral endpoints

authenticated.description: Whether a valid Bearer token was supplied

scopes.description: Token scopes; empty array when anonymous

models.description: Public model names allowed for the current token; same order as /v1/models

count.description: Matches the /mcp tools/list count; requires the connections scope

apps.description: Micro apps enabled / automatically active for the current user; requires the hub scope

skills.description: Skill and prompt summaries visible to the current user (no bodies); requires the hub scope

revision.description: Capability catalog revision; requires the hub scope

name.description: Micro app identifier; the web address is /a/<name>

launch.description: How to open it in the Harness (new/resume etc., defined by DSH semantics)

delivery.description: auto: automatically active; optional: the employee must enable it

web.description: Whether the web version /a/<name> is available

model.description: A public dsh-ee model name (call GET /v1/models first)

ChatCompletionRequest.description: The request body is forwarded upstream as-is except for model; for streaming, the server adds stream_options.include_usage; /v1/embeddings, /v1/responses, and /v1/completions are not supported.

ChatCompletionResponse.description: Subset of OpenAI chat completions; the upstream response body is returned as-is.

type.description: Error category, e.g. authentication_error / permission_error / invalid_request_error / not_found_error / server_error

code.description: Stable error code; see Discovery.errors.codes for values

request_id.description: Request ID, matching the X-Request-Id response header

retry_after.description: Suggested backoff in seconds (only present on retryable errors)

supported_versions.description: For unsupported_api_version, the API major versions supported by the server

OpenAIError.description: OpenAI error envelope of the /v1 model gateway (shape unchanged)

model.description: A public dsh-ee model name (call GET /v1/models first); no claude-* name mapping is performed

max_tokens.description: Required; per-request output limit, consistent with the OpenAI gateway

system.description: System prompt: a string or an array of text blocks

messages.description: Anthropic messages array; supports text / image / tool_use / tool_result / thinking content blocks

tools.description: Client-defined tools {name, description?, input_schema}; server tools (web_search etc.) are ignored

tool_choice.description: auto / any / none / tool; any maps to OpenAI required

stream.description: Returns an Anthropic SSE event stream when true

reasoning_effort.description: DeepSeek-style extension; output_config.effort is also accepted and normalized to OpenAI reasoning_effort

metadata.description: user_id is mapped to OpenAI user; everything else is ignored

AnthropicMessageRequest.description: Anthropic Messages request body; dsh-ee converts it to OpenAI chat completions and forwards it upstream, with model permissions, quota, and usage accounting identical to /v1/chat/completions.

model.description: Public model name requested by the client

content.description: Array of thinking / text / tool_use content blocks

input_tokens.description: prompt_tokens minus cache hits; for streaming, message_delta.usage is authoritative

type.description: Mapped from the HTTP status code: 401 authentication_error, 403 permission_error, 404 not_found_error, 429 rate_limit_error, 413 request_too_large, 5xx api_error/overloaded_error, other 4xx invalid_request_error
